title: Patricio Pitbull Faces Decisive Night at UFC 331 in Los Angeles
seoTitle: Patricio Pitbull Faces Decisive UFC 331 Bout
subtitle: The final fight of Pitbull's contract promises to reshape perception of the athlete in MMA's premier promotion
excerpt: Patricio Pitbull faces Doo Ho Choi at UFC 331 in Los Angeles, in a bout that could define his future in the UFC and draw millions of views.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Patricio Pitbull arrives at UFC 331 in Los Angeles for the final fight of his contract, taking on South Korea's Doo Ho Choi. The matchup, set for the main card, has generated high expectations among MMA fans.

What is at stake for Pitbull at UFC 331

For the Brazilian, the fight represents an opportunity to prove he still has untapped potential in the promotion, following results he considered below expectations. The athlete stated that he wants to “bring his potential to the surface” and that a victory could influence the UFC leadership's decision regarding his future.

Who Doo Ho Choi is and why he attracts attention

Doo Ho Choi, known as the “Korean Superboy,” had already caught Pitbull's attention by calling out the Brazilian after a victory in May. The South Korean returned to the Octagon in 2023, won three consecutive fights by submission, and has been amassing significant views with his “UFC: Embedded” video series. To date, the series has garnered over 2.3 million views.

How Choi's video series influences the matchup

Although he has only 218,000 YouTube subscribers, Choi's five-part series has already surpassed 299,000 additional views, reinforcing the public's interest in the fighters' preparation. This content has contributed to the fight being followed by a significant number of viewers across streaming platforms.

Expectations and potential bonuses

Beyond the contractual matter, Pitbull mentioned the possibility of receiving the $50,000 “pure chaos” bonus offered by Dana White. The fighter described the bonus as “a good deal” and believes the showdown with Choi will be a fireworks display.

Impact of the fight on the featherweight landscape

With both athletes holding relevant positions in the division, the outcome could alter the rankings and open new opportunities. A victory for Pitbull could change the perception of fans who do not yet know him from his stint in Bellator, while a triumph for Choi would bolster his ascent following his return to the Octagon.

With information from Bloody Elbow, AOL.com.
